rules.interaction: Statewide floor; local ordinances may add to it.

any.unavailable: hotel, motel or guest house rented to transient or seasonal tenant, or trust/immediate-family-occupied unit

rules.exemptions: Owner-occupied premises with not more than two rental units; hotels, motels and guest houses for transient or seasonal tenants; certain trust-held units and units occupied by immediate family of the owner
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential leases of houses, buildings, mobile homes and tenements
rules.title: NJ Anti-Eviction Act: grounds for removal of tenants
rules.requirement: A landlord can evict a residential tenant only on a listed ground, such as non-payment, disorderly conduct, property damage, lease violations, habitual late payment, conversion, owner occupancy of small buildings, or specified criminal offenses.
rules.key_value: eviction only for statutory good cause (grounds a to r)
rules.quoted_span: No lessee or tenant or the assigns, under-tenants or legal representatives of such lessee or tenant may be removed by the Superior Court from any house, building, mobile home or land in a mobile home park or tenement leased for residential purposes

notes: Justia mirror of the codified statute. Text gives only amendment years (last 2013, c.51) and original L.1974 c.49, no effective date for the current version, so effective_date is null. Relocation and notice sections (2A:18-61.2 etc.) are not in this page.
